path_block:
/v1/admin/billing/credit-grants:
    post:
      tags: [Administration]
      operationId: createAdminCreditGrant
      x-kokoro-owner: kokoro-bff
      x-kokoro-visibility: public
      x-kokoro-stability: beta
      x-kokoro-idempotency: required
      x-kokoro-permission: admin.billing.credit_grant
      summary: Issue non-cash whole Credits to a current-tenant member
      description: >-
        Current Product platform administrator and recipient membership are rechecked before dispatch.
        No query parameters. Preserve the complete body, Idempotency-Key and permanent funding_id on
        explicit recovery, including effective_at frozen at first submission. A timeout, transport failure
        or invalid acknowledgement does not prove no funds were issued; never create a new command to retry.
        This operation is not a cash payment or a manual usage charge. Tenant, actor, source and price are server-owned.
      parameters:
        - name: Idempotency-Key
          in: header
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            minLength: 8
            maxLength: 128
            pattern: '^[\x21-\x2b\x2d-\x7e]{8,128}$(?![\s\S])'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/AdminCreditGrantRequest' }
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Exact owner issuance receipt, also returned for a valid replay
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/AdminCreditGrantResponse' }
        '400': { $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest' }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ServiceAuthFailed' }
        '403': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ServiceAuthFailed' }
        '409': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Conflict' }
        '429': { $ref: '#/components/responses/TooManyRequests' }
        '502': { $ref: '#/components/responses/BadGateway' }
        '503': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ServiceUnavailable' }
schema_block:
AdminCreditGrantRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - funding_id
        - subject_id
        - amount_credits
        - reason
        - effective_at
      properties:
        funding_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          pattern: ^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$(?![\s\S])
        subject_id:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
        amount_credits:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 13
          pattern: ^[1-9][0-9]{0,12}$(?![\s\S])
          description: Whole Credits, not micros. Maximum 9223372036854; server multiplies
            by 1000000 using BigInt and rejects overflow.
        reason:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 500
        effective_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          pattern: ^[1-9][0-9]{3}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}\.[0-9]{3}Z$(?![\s\S])
          description: UTC millisecond business intent frozen by the BFF at first
            submission; never regenerated on retry.
    AdminCreditGrantResponse:
      type: object
      required: [data, meta]
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        data:
          type: object
          required: [account_id, grant_id, journal_id]
          additionalProperties: false
          properties:
            account_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
            grant_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
            journal_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
        meta: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/RequestMeta' }
